reproduced_defects: A backlog task could replace its immutable gate, blocker and evidence scope with a smaller mutable override and pass accepted-task validation.
The accepted-task validator required roadmap IDs such as TG-V3-002 in evidence, while the evidence schema rejected every TG-V3 task ID, making legitimate roadmap acceptance impossible.
Without a digest-bound milestone semantic projection, a future status-only edit could remove a roadmap dependency, gap or evidence class before acceptance.

Gap severity, owner, blocked claims, affected paths, close criteria, evidence types, issue links and external-dependency meaning could all be rewritten in a status change; the five real control entry points accepted the reduced P0 data gap.
implemented: Digest-bound 120-task identity, dependency, gate membership and workstream scope; unspecified tasks remain planned.
Digest-bound product-gate semantic scope with derived canonical blockers and evidence classes for accepted backlog tasks.
Every accepted backlog task requires all canonical gates passed for one exact target and retained evidence mapped to both task and gate with full type coverage.
Digest-bound current-milestone identities, dependencies, gaps, deliverables, acceptance clauses and required evidence; only status, target and evidence references are mutable.
Evidence schema supports canonical TG-W backlog and TG-V3 roadmap task IDs while rejecting malformed or unapproved version namespaces.
Existing shared retained-evidence admission and product-gate derivation remain the only credit and gate-status authorities.

Digest-bind the complete 18-gap semantic projection and route every gap, gate and execution consumer through one shared validator; mutable status cannot downgrade severity, remove a criterion/type/gap or hide an unresolved external dependency.
validation_rule: Local regression results are retained separately with the exact tested tree; this record alone grants no execution, gap, gate or product acceptance credit.
limitations: Validates current snapshot assertions, not historical Git transitions.
Digest pins require reviewed updates when the approved backlog, product-gate semantics or current milestone semantics change.
Does not authenticate live GitHub review provenance, expertise, administrator policy or completeness of every semantic criterion.
Positive tests use synthetic retained evidence and do not manufacture real approval or accepted product evidence.
No Rust, Go, DDL, production workflow definitions, required checks, credentials or existing gap/gate statuses are changed.

gap_evidence_mapping.reproduced_defect: Accepted evidence of the right type and candidate could close an unrelated gap because no exact gap mapping was required.
implemented: Accepted index rows and retained manifests require identical nonempty canonical gap_ids.
Gap closure requires every cited evidence row to map explicitly to the exact gap ID.
Shared admission and the real gap-register consumer both reject cross-gap evidence reuse.

reproduced_before_fix.semantic_mutation: GAP-P0-DATA-001 was downgraded to P2 and stripped to one criterion/type with empty claims, paths and issues.

mutable_fields: resolved external_dependency value on a closed gap
